hotspots.title: Trump provocative maps trigger widespread outrage
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's social media posts depicting expanded US borders—including Canada, Greenland, and Mexico—along with renaming states and bodies of water have drawn severe international backlash. Diplomatic officials from Denmark and Iceland issued formal condemnations, while pop-culture figures and satirists lampooned the administration's expansionist cartography.
hotspots.affect: The map posts have triggered global outrage and severe diplomatic friction alongside intense domestic mockery over territorial sovereignty.

hotspots.title: Trump administration pushes Supreme Court on mail-voting restrictions
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is pressing forward with aggressive voter roll changes, asking the Supreme Court to permit the use of federal databases for citizenship checks while pushing census modifications that exclude non-citizens. State election officials and civil rights advocates express alarm that these late-stage overhauls will disenfranchise voters and alter congressional representation.
hotspots.affect: Focuses deep partisan fear and moral alarm over democratic norms, voting access, and legal battles ahead of the midterms.

hotspots.title: White House AI superhero graphics spark sharp ridicule
hotspots.blurb: The White House and President Trump face intense scrutiny and widespread lampooning over a flood of AI-generated pop-culture graphics depicting Trump as Green Lantern and other fictional characters. Late-night hosts, political commentators, and critics have seized on the posts, raising concerns over presidential fitness and targeting key aides.
hotspots.affect: High affective charge stems from viral ridicule, questions regarding presidential fitness, and sharp cultural backlash against official White House media tactics.

hotspots.title: Tensions rise over Trump administration's indefinite Iran conflict
hotspots.blurb: Renewed controversy surrounds the Trump administration's Middle East strategy following a seven-post social media spree targeting Iran's economy and oil infrastructure. Critics and foreign policy analysts warn of endless involvement and manipulation by foreign allies, even as Congress reviews new regional nuclear commitments.
hotspots.affect: Driven by foreign policy anxiety, fear of regional military escalation, and accusations of strategic manipulation.

hotspots.title: NRCC expands MAGA candidate slate ahead of midterms
hotspots.blurb: The National Republican Congressional Committee is expanding its 'MAGA Majority' program to back conservative candidates in redrawn districts, while broader party dynamics spark friction. A controversial GOP midterm convention in Dallas faced boycotts and attendance struggles from key lawmakers, highlighting intra-party fractures over Trump's central role.
hotspots.affect: Reflects aggressive party mobilization coupled with internal friction over MAGA purity tests and midterm campaign strategy.
